notes.title: Ver.1.3.2 Updated!
notes.content:
[h1]Ver. 1.3.2[/h1]

[h2]◆New features added/changed[/h2]
Added 119 new☑ Junichi voices.
(*17 voices will be added for each world you clear)
(*If you have already cleared the world, they will be added automatically)

[h2]◆Difficulty adjustment[/h2]
☑ Difficulty Easy health is changed from x1.8 to x2.0
☑ Difficulty Easy attack power is changed from x1.2 to x1.5

☑ Difficulty of 7-BOSS has been adjusted
Easy Difficulty
Added Golden Asparagus (recovery item)
☑ Easy and Normal
Changed the attack interval of Omni-directional Barrage from 0.10 seconds to 0.12 seconds.
Changed the attack speed of the omni-directional barrage from 8 to 7.
Changed the angle of the teleport + omni-directional barrage from 30 to 45.
Changed the number of lasers in some areas.

[h2]◆Fixed bugs and glitches[/h2]
☑ Fixed freezing in World Map

☑ Fixed a bug that World 7 is shown in World Map

☑ Fixed freeze during loading when you start 3-1 on Hard difficulty

☑ Fixed a bug that key configs are not saved properly

notes.title: Announcement of scheduled difficulty adjustment update
notes.content:
We are planning to update the game in Ver. 1.3.0 soon to adjust the difficulty level including bug fixes.
If you have any requests for difficulty adjustment, features you would like to see added, or reports of bugs or problems, please contact us at the following contact page or the creator's Twitter account.

Contact page: [url=https://junk.7shi321.net/support/]https://junk.7shi321.net/support/[/url]
Creator Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/7shi321]https://twitter.com/7shi321[/url]
